senses.definition: An amount of time or a particular time interval.
senses.example: The duration of the flight will be about 2 hours 45 minutes.

senses.definition: The time taken for the current situation to end, especially the current war.
senses.example: Rationing will last at least for the duration.

senses.definition: A measure of the sensitivity of the price of a financial asset to changes in interest rates, computed for a simple bond as a weighted average of the maturities of the interest and principal payments associated with it.
